status: PROPOSED by Claude, pending review by José. Not in labels.json. Coverage accuracy in the harness is scored against these and reported as provisional.
definition: coverage_decision a correct system should give: covered, not_covered or needs_review. Derived from the decided clause_ids and signals: needs_review when a doubt clause (1.1, 6.4, 7.1, 7.2, 4.6, 4.7) or a weather mismatch applies, otherwise covered.
note: No golden case triggers an exclusion that denies the whole claim (racing, intoxication, unlisted driver), so not_covered is never proposed and that class is untested. The golden set must grow with such cases.
